result: I’d make empathy accurately scalable: people would genuinely register the consequences of their actions on others—especially strangers, future generations, and people with less power—before self-interest or ideology could edit them out. Not forced compassion, just a harder-to-bypass awareness of other minds. A lot of deliberate cruelty and cowardice depends on that awareness failing.
